author: Dokyle
body:
Hello, Im FanOfYazda, best know as Dokihl and I was permanently banned by "Bow aimbot" some days ago.

First, I will try to be really honest.

I recognize that I said " I´m using BowAimbot, But I was just joking with my friends, I wasn´t even using it, I´m really sorry about saying that, I know I shouldn´t say that but now I learn.

I didn´t use any kind of Hack on Avicus, I swear it, I really like Avicus and I have a lot of friend here and I really like the community, I wouldn´t use any kind of thing that make me be "Illegal" on a server.


If you don´t believe me I can share my screen and see if I have anything, Also I can make a video playing with bow "Legit" If u wish

Thanks for reading and please comprehensive!


This is BowAimbot: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8F6fBKftW0Y


This not is BowAimbot: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TQgUC6c6ZPM&feature=youtu.be
